description: EJScreen: Get EJScreen environmental-justice indicators for a point and surrounding buffer. Returns the 13 EJScreen environmental indicators (PM2.5, ozone, diesel particulate, NO2, lead paint, traffic proximity, Superfund/RMP/hazardous-waste/wastewater proximity, underground storage tanks, drinking-water non-compliance, and RSEI toxic air releases) and 6 demographic indicators (people of color, low income, limited English, less than high school, under 5, over 64), each with national and state percentiles plus EJ Index values, along with the Demographic Index and Supplemental Demographic Index and their national averages. Data is EJAM's ACS 2018–2022 release of EJScreen (EJScreen 2.3 method), served via the community-maintained EJAM API (api.ejanalysis.com, Public Environmental Data Partners), which rehosts EJScreen after EPA discontinued public access in 2025 — not a live EPA endpoint. Provide latitude, longitude, and a buffer distance (default 1 mile, max 15 miles). When EJScreen has no indicators — the point is outside its US bounds, the buffer holds no Census block, or its blocks have no residents — coverage.valid is false and coverage.note says which, and whether a larger distance may help.

distance.description: Buffer radius around the point, in the given unit (default 1). The miles-equivalent must be 15 or less.

unit.description: Unit for distance. Kilometers are converted to miles (× 0.621371) before the request.

name: epa_ejscreen_get_scores

coverage.description: Whether EJScreen had data for the buffer.

note.description: Present when valid is false: what EJScreen found, and whether a larger distance may reach data.

valid.description: False when EJScreen has no indicators: the point is outside its US bounds, or the buffer holds no Census block or no residents.

dataSource.description: Provenance and vintage of the data.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the state-normalized index, built from z-scores within the state.

usAverage.description: National average; absent when EJScreen omits it.

value.description: Mean of the national z-scores for percent low income and percent people of color, shifted so the lowest block group scores 0. Unitless; higher is more disadvantaged.

ejIndex.description: EJ Index: the Demographic Index × this indicator's US percentile, per block group, population-weighted over the buffer.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `buffer_too_large`: The buffer exceeds the EJAM API's 15-mile cap (kilometers converted first). `upstream_rejected`: The EJAM API answered HTTP 400 for a point inside its accepted bounds, so the failure is at EJAM, not in the coordinates. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

location.description: Queried point and buffer; state, stateName, population, and blockGroupCount are absent when the buffer holds no Census block.

blockGroupCount.description: Census block groups intersecting the buffer.

bufferMiles.description: Buffer radius in miles (kilometer input converted).

population.description: Area-weighted population in the buffer; 0 when its blocks have no residents.

notice.description: The coverage note as guidance, when no indicators were returned.

reportUrl.description: Absolute URL of the full EJScreen report for this point and buffer.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the state-normalized index, built from z-scores within the state.

usAverage.description: National average; absent when EJScreen omits it.

value.description: Mean of the national z-scores for percent low income, limited English, less than high school education, and with disabilities, plus low life expectancy (four when it is missing), shifted so the lowest block group scores 0. Unitless; higher is more disadvantaged.

title: Get EJScreen Environmental Justice Indicators
